description:
modules/parentbilling — GET /traeger/billing-runs/{id}/cost-takeovers/{costBearerId}/export
(#5627), every statement: the Träger transaction and its binding, the
run, the cost bearer, the issued documents and their positions in one
statement each, through Enrollment the period and its confirmed
registrations with children, bookings and whether a proof exists (in bulk)
with the entry in the period's trail, the confirmation days and the entry
in the run's trail. No statement per document or registration.
